text:
Mira: Kickoff for a visibility lane for model rollouts. Customers want: per-model cost deltas, error-rate diffs, and traceable request->token attribution to investigate regressions. Need to pick scope for Q2.
Priya: TL;DR acceptance criteria (draft): 1) Dashboard card that shows cost and error delta by model variant for last 24/7/30d, 2) Drill from tile to span-level trace with model_variant + rollout_tag, 3) CSV export for finance + sales, 4) Privacy: tenant ids must be hashed in traces.
Diego: Engineering reality check: getting model_variant into traces is straightforward at request boundary; per-token attribution across batching + prefix cache is harder. Also cross-region fallbacks will lose live context unless we propagate a request_id.
Omar: SRE concerns: if we propagate per-token metadata into hot path, we'll add ~5-12% tail latency depending on kernel + batching. Need bench numbers. We should consider sampling (1-5%) for full attribution and aggregated counters for the rest.
Tess: From customer side (Enterprise A/B): they need sample-level attribution for 10 important tenants for billing disputes; aggregated delta is fine for others. This suggests a hybrid approach.
eng-bot: perf-benchmark queued: job id perf-8421, ETA 48h.
Mira: Proposal: three delivery options to present to GTM and Eng leadership.
Priya: Option MVP (fast): dashboard aggregates showing cost/error by model_variant; include a drill link that opens a filtered traces page but only with request-level tags (no per-token mapping). Sampling toggle for tenants that need detailed logs.
Diego: Option MID: propagate model_variant + hashed_tenant_id through runtime and most cache/batching paths; provide sampled per-token attribution for 95% of common code paths. Requires 2 runtime sprints + 1 UI sprint.
Omar: Option FULL: exact per-token attribution including cross-region fallbacks, dedicated pools, and reroute compatibility. Big runtime changes, kernel-level microbenching, plus canary rollout gates. Risk: potential tail latency regressions.
Tess: Pricing ask: if we deliver MID, sales will package per-tenant sampling as "forensic audit" add-on. Good to know for prioritization.
Priya: Draft launch criteria per option: MVP = aggregated dashboard + drill link + sampling flag; MID = add hashed tenant propagation + sampled per-token attribution + CSV export; FULL = end-to-end exact mapping + SLO for tail latency + regression alerts.
Diego: Pseudocode for span attributes we discussed (attach at request and flush at token emission):
```
span.set_attr("hashed_tenant", hash(req.tenant_id))
span.set_attr("model_variant", req.model_variant)

# when emitting tokens inside runtime loop
for token in emit_tokens():
  token_span = tracer.start_span("token.emit")
  token_span.set_attr("model_variant", req.model_variant)
  token_span.set_attr("req_id", req.request_id)
  token_span.end()
```
Omar: Note: token_span creation in hot loop will blow up CPU if done naively. Consider batching token spans into aggregated counters per-request and emit one trace sample per N tokens.
Mira: Compliance note: must add a toggle to control whether tenant_id is hashed or redacted. Default = hash. Add privacy review before rollout.
eng-bot: canary deploy window reserved: 2026-05-12T08:00:00Z to 2026-05-12T12:00:00Z.
Diego: Implementation estimate: MVP = 3 dev-weeks (UI + trace link), MID = 8 dev-weeks (runtime + QA + UI), FULL = 16+ weeks and requires dedicated benchmarking sprint.
Priya: Let's prepare a decision doc with estimated customer impact and revenue signal per option. Also include required QA: sampling verification, e2e repro for billing dispute case, and regression suite for tail latency.
Tess: I'll gather customer use-cases and mark top 10 tenants for early access.
Mira: Scheduling prioritization meeting Wed 9am PT. Please add owners and pre-read to the invite.
Priya: I'll draft the pre-read and acceptance criteria doc tonight and post link.
Diego: I'll attach perf numbers from perf-8421 once it finishes.
Omar: I'll bring rollback/toggle plan and canary metrics to the meeting.
Mira: Thanks all. Goal: choose MVP vs MID by Wed so SRE can reserve bench time. :calendar:
